snippet.title: God of War Sons of Sparta - We Are Mega Cat | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Available on PS5® today! 
Purchase Now or Learn More: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/god-of-war-sons-of-sparta/

Meet Mega Cat Studios, lead developers on God of War Sons of Sparta, in our first behind-the-scenes video about game’s creation!  

Founded in Pittsburgh, PA – Mega Cat Studios has a deep passion for retro games that been their driving inspiration since their earliest days making cartridges in a kitchen. Now a global team of seasoned experts, MCS brings their extensive knowledge of the genre and love for the God of War series together in the brand-new 2D action platformer God of War Sons of Sparta. 

#ps5 #ps5games #godofwar
